title: Chapter 368 Summoning Channel
content:
Chapter 368 Summoning Channel

After nearly a day of practice, Wang Shuo finally practiced the "Black Dragon Sutra" to the fifth level, and at the same time comprehended the fifth level move - Flying Dragon in the Sky.

In the secret room of the Ksitigarbha Pavilion, Wang Shuo stood up, shouted loudly, and used the gun technique to perform this move.

In an instant, a black dragon flew out, galloped into the air, and directly reached the ceiling of the secret room.

Wang Shuo guessed that if it were not for the ceiling, the black dragon would probably fly higher.

After circling for a while, the black dragon quickly pounced on a wooden stake under Wang Shuo's will.

The wooden stake was immediately smashed into powder.

Wang Shuo's eyes widened, unbelievable.

After a while, the wooden stake returned to its original state again.

Wang Shuo used another move, the dragon out of the sea.

The wooden stake was also smashed into pieces, but the bottom of the wooden stake was still there.

Wang Shuo had a preliminary understanding of the power of these two moves.

If a move of "Dragon Out of the Sea" can kill an ordinary silver boss directly without any defense, then this move of "Flying Dragon in the Sky" can kill an ordinary gold boss directly with the infusion of internal force.

Wang Shuo was shocked. Once upon a time, he was just a high-level general who was on par with the yellow-level boss.

More than a month has passed, and now it is no longer the same as before.

It seems that the time to summon into the second channel of the War General Tower has matured.

When he was sorting out the spoils before, as long as he collected 99 pieces of Shura Orders, there would be a prompt whether to summon the channel.

This forced Wang Shuo to divide the Shura Order into several parts and bury them in several places in Chitong Mountain.

It's time to take them out.

The value of the Shura Order is 10,000 Shura coins. Wang Shuo consigned all the extra Shura Orders.

His current strength is far beyond that of other people in Yingying Town. When he came to the Treasure Pavilion, the receptionist was so scared that he dared not breathe.

Anyone who suddenly saw nearly a hundred Shura Orders would be shocked.

Wang Shuo sold all the Shura Orders to the Treasure Pavilion in three installments.

Wang Shuo was not sure whether these Shura coins and Shura Orders would still be useful on the second floor. He could only use the Shura coins to buy supplies, mainly various elixirs.

Maybe these elixirs could be taken back to Wana County and given to his men.

Another day later, Wang Shuo finished dealing with all the affairs in Yingying Town. After fasting and bathing, he prepared to summon the passage.

This day, the sky was clear and the wind was gentle.

Wang Shuo changed into a new set of clothes.

Standing in the courtyard, Wang Shuo asked the servant to hand over the previous Shura Orders to him.

Wang Shuo had 150 Shura Orders on him.

Wang Shuo also wanted to see if the extra Shura Orders would be useful later and whether he could take them out.

[100 Shura Orders have been collected. Do you want to summon the passage? 】

"Yes."

Instantly, the world suddenly changed, and a beam of light like a searchlight in the sky enveloped Wang Shuo.

It was like ascending.

Wang Shuo was led by the beam to a closed space.

A huge square between the clouds and mists seemed to be in the sea of clouds.

In front of Wang Shuo was a general puppet.

The puppet's outer armor, shining with dazzling metallic luster, was made of unknown metal and craftsmanship, and it was obvious that it was extremely hard.

Wang Shuo used the reconnaissance skill to check, and only got the name of the general puppet.

Other information was not presented in a digital way.

Wang Shuo could only concentrate and be alert.
